causality.title: Evidence level: {level}
causality.descriptive_only: These are descriptive results: they describe current views and levels, and neither measure change nor prove impact.
causality.perceived_change: This is change as perceived by participants themselves, not a direct measurement of change.
causality.trend_only: Results show the direction of indicators over time, not the cause of that direction.
causality.change_not_cause: Comparing waves shows that change happened, but not that the program caused it — other factors may have contributed.
causality.contribution: Comparison with non-participants strengthens the conclusion that the program contributed to the change, without making it a definitive causal attribution.
causality.attribution: A randomized design allows attributing the change to the program within the limits of the sample and period.

SALLA.name: Salla
SALLA.tagline: Through a free private app in the Partners portal
SALLA.triggerHint: Salla sends the “delivered” status when the order is delivered.
steps: In the Salla Partners portal create a private app for your store (free) and install it.
In the app's webhook settings choose the “Signature” security strategy, paste the webhook URL below and subscribe to order.status.updated.
Copy the app's Webhook Secret and paste it in the signing secret field below.
Use “Send a test order”, then move a real order to “delivered”.

ZID.name: Zid
ZID.tagline: Through a private app in the Zid Partner dashboard
ZID.triggerHint: Zid sends the delivered status; the webhook can be limited to it.
steps: In the Zid Partner dashboard create a private app and connect it to your store.
Register a webhook for order.status.update on the URL below (optionally limited to status delivered).
Use Basic authentication with the username and secret shown below (the secret is the password).
Use “Send a test order” to try the link.

SHOPIFY.name: Shopify
SHOPIFY.triggerHint: “On shipping” with the Order fulfillment event is recommended; for delivery use Fulfillment update.
steps: In Shopify admin open Settings → Notifications → Webhooks and click “Create webhook”.
Pick the Order fulfillment event (or Fulfillment update to measure on delivery), JSON format, and paste the URL below.
Copy the signing key shown under the webhook list and paste it in the signing secret field below.
Use “Send a test order” to try the link.

WOOCOMMERCE.name: WooCommerce
steps: In WordPress open WooCommerce → Settings → Advanced → Webhooks and click “Add webhook”.
Status: Active, Topic: Order updated, Delivery URL: the URL below.
Paste the secret below in the Secret field and save.
Use “Send a test order” to try the link.

CUSTOM.name: Other system
CUSTOM.tagline: Any system that sends a signed request (API)
CUSTOM.triggerHint: Send the status delivered or fulfilled in the status field.
steps: When an order's status changes, POST JSON to the URL below (see the sample).
Sign it with the X-Meqyas-Signature header: t=timestamp,v1=HMAC-SHA256 with the secret of “timestamp.body”.
The response contains the invitation links to send through your own channels (WhatsApp or SMS).

LINK.title: Links your store sends
LINK.body: MEQYAS creates a personal link per order and product; find them in the Invitations tab and in the webhook response for automation tools (WhatsApp/SMS). No paid service.

EMAIL.title: E-mail from MEQYAS
EMAIL.body: MEQYAS e-mails the customer after the delay you set, then deletes the address immediately.
EMAIL.unavailable: Needs the platform's mail server (SMTP) to be configured first.

qr.title: QR code
qr.body: On the table or at the till; customers scan it with their phone camera, no app needed.

kiosk.title: Tablet by the exit
kiosk.body: A dedicated mode that starts a fresh rating after each customer and keeps no answers on the device.

pos.title: POS receipt
pos.body: The till sends the branch code with each sale, and the customer receives their own rating link.

qr.title: {name} — code & links

pos.title: Point-of-sale (POS) connection
pos.body: If your till sends sales to a “Custom” connection in the Online stores tab, add the branch code in the branch field: the customer receives a rating link for that sale (on the receipt or by message), credited to the branch.

cards.title: Branch QR cards
cards.hint: Four cards per A4 page — cut them out for tables or the till.
cards.headline: How was your visit?
cards.sub: A few taps — under a minute
cards.noSurvey: Publish a survey first to print branch codes.

intelligence.title: Insights
intelligence.subtitle: Insights computed from your project's data by fixed rules; each one is linked to its evidence: the indicator, dimension or question, the sample size and the wave.

evidence.subtitle: What this insight is based on

analyst.subtitle: Ask about your project's results; it answers from computed numbers only and cites the source of each.
suggestions: What is the biggest problem in the results?
What improved the most between waves?
Write a short summary for management
analyst.thinking: The analyst is reading the numbers…
analyst.grounded: It never computes new numbers and never sees individual responses.

recommendations.title: Recommendations
recommendations.subtitle: Practical actions that respond to the insights. AI proposes them from the evidence; you approve and track them.
recommendations.emptyHint: Generate insights first, then click “Suggest recommendations” — or add one yourself.
recommendations.note: The possible cause is a hypothesis to check, not a finding proven by the data.

new.working: Preparing the report: computing the figures, then drafting the text…

EXECUTIVE.name: Executive report
EXECUTIVE.description: Two pages for decision makers: the key results, figures and what is needed.

DETAILED.name: Detailed report
DETAILED.description: The full picture for the project team: method, every table and the insights.

IMPACT.name: Impact report
IMPACT.description: For funders and partners: what changed, how strongly, and the limits of the conclusion.

MANAGEMENT.name: Management report
MANAGEMENT.description: Indicators against targets, risks, decisions and the action plan.

ACADEMIC.description: A neutral research structure: abstract, method, statistical results and limitations.

toneHints.PLAIN: Short sentences; statistical terms explained in everyday words.
toneHints.ANALYTICAL: Discusses effect sizes, significance and differences between waves and groups.

refresh.title: Refresh the report
refresh.description: Creates a new version from the project's current data; earlier versions stay unchanged.

long_term_impact.title: Long-term impact
long_term_impact.hint: The lasting change the program contributes to

nps.body: Would the customer recommend you? The world's most used loyalty measure.

csat.title: Customer satisfaction (CSAT)
csat.body: How was it just now? The share of customers satisfied with the visit or order.

ces.title: Customer effort (CES)

keep.title: Keep it up
keep.hint: Matters and performs well — your strengths
